plain_description.what: A pre-registered rule, with no new calls, that combines three other tests to decide which sentence the thesis may write about the taxonomy. The candidates were: the expected sentence, 'an evaluation lever', or 'a filing device only'.
plain_description.why: It fixes in advance how the thesis's main claim about the tree's value must change given the results, so the wording cannot be chosen after seeing the data.
plain_description.information: A routing or filing advantage over k-means would let the thesis call the tree an evaluation lever; losing the top-level certificate would narrow it to a filing device. Result: 'a filing device only'. The presented tree has no certified top-level split, so its certificate clause is withdrawn. Neither lever condition fired. Filing lost to k-means built within each class. Routing was not distinguishable from per-source k-means (difference within noise). The record explicitly avoids saying 'no lever'.
